title_zh: 長者醫療券計劃 $2,000/年
value_summary_en: $2,000/yr, cap $4,000. +$500 reward if $1,000 spent on designated PHC in same year.
why_en: You are 65+ HK resident.
why_zh: 你年滿65歲並為香港居民。

title_zh: 長者醫療券獎賞先導計劃 $500 (2026)
value_summary_en: Spend $1,000 on designated PHC in 2026 → $500 reward, use by end 2027.
value_summary_zh: 2026年內指定基層醫療用滿$1,000 → 賞$500，2027年底前用。
why_en: Same as HCV, plus 2026 spend window.
why_zh: 同醫療券資格，並在2026年有用券。
proof_needed_zh: 醫療券戶口同年指定基層醫療用滿$1,000

title_zh: 長者咭 (65歲+)
value_summary_en: Proof of age for concessions on transport, gov services, shops.
value_summary_zh: 年齡證明，享交通、政府及商戶優惠。
why_en: You are 65+.
why_zh: 你年滿65歲。

title_zh: $2優惠計劃 (60歲+ 樂悠咭)
value_summary_en: $2 flat or pay 20% (80% off) (reform eff 3 Apr 2026). 60+ via JoyYou Card. <60 disabled via DA/CSSA-100% Personalised Octopus.
value_summary_zh: $2或兩折(2026年4月3日改制)。60歲+用JoyYou卡；60歲以下殘疾經傷殘津貼/綜援100%個人八達通。
why_en: You are 60+. Get a JoyYou Card.
why_zh: 你年滿60歲，申請JoyYou卡即享。
proof_needed_zh: 樂悠咭(60歲+)/殘疾身份八達通(60歲以下)

title_zh: 長者社區照顧服務券 (最高$10,824/月)
value_summary_en: Money-following-user home/centre care for frail elderly after SCNAMES assessment. Co-pay by affordability.
value_summary_zh: 經統一評估後，體弱長者自選服務單位，政府按負擔能力共同付款。
why_en: Household has elderly needing care. Requires assessment.
why_zh: 家中有需要照顧長者，需經評估。
proof_needed_zh: 安老服務統一評估機制評估
confirm_en: SWD invites by CWL application-date batches; or apply via VISE
confirm_zh: 社署按中央輪候冊日期分批邀請，亦可經VISE網上申請

title_en: Kindergarten and Child Care Centre Fee Remission Scheme
title_zh: 幼稚園及幼兒中心學費減免計劃
value_summary_en: 100%/75%/50% fee remission for K1-K3 (non-profit KG scheme). AFI ≤89,515.
value_summary_zh: K1-K3學費減免100%/75%/50%，家庭入息限額AFI。
why_en: You have a K1-K3 child and pass income test.
why_zh: 你有K1-K3子女並通過入息審查。

title_zh: 幼稚園學生就學開支津貼
value_summary_en: Extra grant on top of KCFRS, autopay from Sep.
value_summary_zh: KCFRS以外額外津貼，9月起自動轉賬。
why_en: Same as KCFRS.
why_zh: 與KCFRS相同資格。

title_en: School Textbook Assistance + Student Travel Subsidy + Internet Subsidy (one SFO form)
title_zh: 學校書簿津貼+學生車船津貼+上網費津貼 (一表通辦)
value_summary_en: One form SFO 75B covers TA, STS (>10min walk), SIA (P/S, household). Autopay Oct/Nov.
value_summary_zh: 一表申請學校書簿津貼、學生車船津貼(>10分鐘路程)、上網費津貼，10-11月發放。
why_en: You have a P/S child and pass income test.
why_zh: 你有中小學子女並通過入息審查。

title_zh: 課餘託管計劃收費減免 (小學)
value_summary_en: Full / half / 1-3 waiving when parents work or job-search.
value_summary_zh: 家長工作/求職未能照顧，減免全費/半費/三分一。
why_en: Primary child + working parents + low income.
why_zh: 小學子女、家長工作、低收入。

title_en: Working Family Allowance Scheme + Child Allowance
title_zh: 在職家庭津貼計劃及兒童津貼
value_summary_en: Basic $575-1,150 / Medium $690-1,380 / Higher $805-1,610 per household + per child $805-1,610, at full/¾/half rates by exact income × household-size table (2026-27).
why_en: Working household meeting hours + income limits. Not on CSSA.
why_zh: 在職家庭符合工時及入息限額，非綜援戶。
confirm_en: Claim in 6-month periods; extra allowance if Budget passes
Child allowance per child <15 (or 15-21 in full-time non-post-secondary)
confirm_zh: 以6個月為一期申領；預算案通過或有額外津貼
每名15歲以下（或15-21歲全日制非專上）子女另有兒童津貼

title_zh: 疫苗資助計劃
value_summary_en: Subsidised flu / pneumococcal shots at enrolled clinics. Check stock before visit.
value_summary_zh: 指定診所享流感/肺炎球菌資助，去前先問有無貨。
why_en: All residents — check clinic list by district.
why_zh: 所有居民適用，按地區查診所名單。

title_en: Comprehensive Social Security Assistance Safety Net
title_zh: 綜合社會保障援助(綜援)安全網
value_summary_en: Means-tested basic + rent/school/medical special grants. Cannot get WFA at same time.
value_summary_zh: 經濟審查基本金 + 租金/學費/醫療特別津貼，不可與WFA同領。
why_en: Low-income household not working enough hours for WFA.
why_zh: 低收入且工時不足申請WFA的家庭。

title_en: Public Transport Fare Subsidy Scheme (up to $400/mo)
title_zh: 公共交通費用補貼計劃 (最高$400/月)
value_summary_en: 1/3 of monthly expenses over $500 back, cap $400/mo per Octopus/AlipayHK. No application, collect from 16th.
value_summary_zh: 月費超$500部份回贈1/3，上限$400/月。免申請，每月16日起拍卡領取。
why_en: Your monthly transport spend exceeds $500.
why_zh: 你每月車費超過$500。

title_zh: 長者生活津貼 $4,345/月
value_summary_en: $4,345/mo. Single: income ≤$10,900 + assets ≤$415,000. Couple: ≤$16,680 + ≤$630,000. Not with OAA/DA/CSSA.
why_en: You are 65+ within income/asset limits.
why_zh: 你年滿65歲並符合入息資產限額，且非領綜合社會保障援助/高齡津貼/傷殘津貼。
confirm_en: Not on talent/student/working-holiday visas or as their dependants
confirm_zh: 並非以人才/學生/工作假期簽證留港（及其受養人）

title_zh: 高齡津貼 $1,675/月 (免審查)
value_summary_en: $1,675/mo for 70+. No income/asset test. 7-yr residence.
value_summary_zh: 70歲+每月$1,675，免入息資產審查，需居港7年。
why_en: You are 70+. Fallback if OALA limits exceeded.
why_zh: 你年滿70歲，OALA超額都仲有。
confirm_en: Not on talent/student/working-holiday visas or as their dependants
confirm_zh: 並非以人才/學生/工作假期簽證留港（及其受養人）

value_summary_en: Non-means-tested: Normal $2,140/mo, Higher $4,280/mo (needs constant attendance, not in subsidised care), +$345/mo transport supplement age 12-64. From 1 Feb 2026.
value_summary_zh: 免審查：普通$2,140/月、高額$4,280/月（需人長期照顧、非住資助院舍），12-64歲另加$345/月交通補助。2026年2月1日起。
why_en: Household includes a severely disabled member.
why_zh: 家中有重度殘疾成員。
proof_needed_zh: 醫生評估(衞生署/醫管局)
confirm_en: Higher tier: constant attendance + not in subsidised residential care/HA/special-school boarding
confirm_zh: 高額須有人長期照顧＋非住資助院舍／公院／特殊學校宿舍

title_zh: 居屋白表 (資助出售房屋)
value_summary_en: Periodic sales (HOS 2025: 6,926 flats). 1p: income ≤$30k, assets ≤$615k. 2+: ≤$60k/≤$1.23M. No property. Fee ~$350.
why_en: Private-housing household within White Form limits. Watch for sale windows.
why_zh: 私樓戶符合白表限額，留意發售期。
confirm_en: MPF employee contributions are deductible from declared income
confirm_zh: 強積金僱員供款可從申報入息扣減

title_zh: 居屋綠表 (公屋戶)
value_summary_en: PRH / HKHS Group A households buy with no income/asset limit. 24-mo no-property rule. Priority quotas for elderly/newborn families.
value_summary_zh: 公屋/房協甲類屋邨戶免入息資產審查，24個月無物業規定。有長者/新生嬰兒優先配額。
why_en: PRH household — cheapest path to ownership.
why_zh: 公屋住戶置業的經濟之選。

title_zh: 持續進修基金 $25,000
value_summary_en: Up to $25k course fee reimbursement. First $10k you pay 20%, rest 40%. Claim within 1yr of completion. 18+, no upper age limit.
value_summary_zh: 最高$25k學費發還，首$10k自付20%、餘額40%。完成1年內申領。18歲+無上限。
why_en: Adult learner — use it before the account lapses.
why_zh: 成年進修適用，善用進修資助增值自己。

title_zh: 僱員再培訓局再培訓津貼
value_summary_en: Placement-tied 7+ days: $333/day ($167 youth), max $8k/mo, once/yr. Course fee waiver if monthly income ≤$15k, subsidised ≤$23.5k.
value_summary_zh: 就業掛鈎7日+課程：$333/日(青年$167)，月上限$8k，每年一次。月入≤$15k免學費，≤$23.5k半費。
why_en: Eligible age for ERB courses and allowance.
why_zh: 符合再培訓局課程年齡。

title_zh: 展翅青見計劃 YETP
value_summary_en: Age 15-29, sub-degree or below: paid workplace attachment ($8,000 allowance), training $333/day, career advisor. Free.
value_summary_zh: 15-29歲副學位或以下：有薪實習($8,000津貼)、培訓$333/日、就業顧問跟進。免費。
why_en: Youth in range — career advisor + paid attachment.
why_zh: 青年符合年齡 — 有顧問跟+有薪實習。

title_zh: 大腸癌篩查計劃 (50-75歲)
value_summary_en: Asymptomatic 50-75: FIT test at 1,000+ clinics, free; positive → colonoscopy in ~8 weeks. Needs eHealth registration.
value_summary_zh: 無病徵50-75歲：千間診所免費大便測試，陽性約8星期內照腸鏡。需eHealth登記。
why_en: You are in screening age — free, repeat every 2 years.
why_zh: 你到篩查年齡 — 免費，兩年一次。

title_zh: 子宮頸篩查計劃 (25-64歲女性)
value_summary_en: Women 25-64 ever sexually active: subsidised screening at MCHC / Woman Health Centre. Booking 3166 6631.
value_summary_zh: 25-64歲曾有性經驗女性：母嬰健康院/婦女健康中心資助篩查。預約3166 6631。
why_en: Eligible age — regular screening saves lives.
why_zh: 符合年齡 — 定期篩查救命。

title_en: Breast Cancer Screening Pilot Programme Phase II (high-risk 35-74)
title_zh: 乳癌篩查先導計劃第二期 (高風險35-74歲)
value_summary_en: High-risk women 35-74 (family history/BRCA): subsidised mammogram via NGOs + DH. Asymptomatic, no screening in past year.
value_summary_zh: 高風險35-74歲女性(家族史/BRCA)：NGO+衛生署資助造影。無病徵、過去一年無照過。
why_en: In age range — get risk assessment to confirm high-risk slot.
why_zh: 年齡符合 — 先做風險評估確認高風險名額。

title_en: Living Allowance for Carers of Elderly Persons from Low-income Families ($3,000/mo)
title_zh: 低收入家庭護老者生活津貼 ($3,000/月)
value_summary_en: $3,000/mo for carers giving 80+ hrs/mo (120+ for 2 elderly). Elderly must be on CWL for long-term care, living in community.
value_summary_zh: 每月$3,000。照顧80小時+/月(2老120小時+)。長者需經安老服務統一評估機制輪候資助長期護理、在社區居住。
confirm_en: Elderly on Central Waiting List for LTC (SCNAMES)
80+ hrs care/mo (120+ if 2 elderly)
Household income within CAST table by size
Carer not employed by the elderly
confirm_zh: 長者經安老服務統一評估機制並輪候資助長期護理
每月照顧80小時+(2老120小時+)
住戶入息符合CAST按人數限額
照顧者非受僱於長者
why_en: You care for an elderly person 80+ hrs/mo and are not on CSSA/OALA/DA.
why_zh: 你每月照顧長者80小時+，且非領綜合社會保障援助/長者生活津貼/傷殘津貼。
proof_needed_zh: 安老服務統一評估+中央輪候冊信件

title_en: Living Allowance for Low-income Carers of Persons with Disabilities ($3,000/mo)
title_zh: 低收入家庭殘疾人士照顧者生活津貼 ($3,000/月)
value_summary_en: $3,000/mo for carers giving 80+ hrs/mo. PWD must be on rehab/special-school/infirmary waitlist, living in community.
value_summary_zh: 每月$3,000。照顧80小時+/月。殘疾人士需輪候康復/特殊學校住宿/療養服務，在社區居住。
confirm_en: PWD on specified rehab waitlist
80+ hrs care/mo (120+ if 2 persons)
Household income within CAST table by size
confirm_zh: 殘疾人士輪候指定康復服務
每月照顧80小時+(2人120小時+)
住戶入息符合CAST按人數限額
why_en: You care for a disabled person 80+ hrs/mo and are not on CSSA/OALA/DA.
why_zh: 你每月照顧殘疾人士80小時+，且非領綜合社會保障援助/長者生活津貼/傷殘津貼。
proof_needed_zh: 輪候信(康復服務中央轉介系統/教育局/醫管局)

title_zh: 照顧者支援專線 182 183 (24小時免費)
value_summary_en: 24hr social-worker hotline: counselling, respite matching, outreach, transport subsidy for respite. WhatsApp 5322 2183 for hearing/speech impaired.
value_summary_zh: 24小時社工專線：輔導、暫託配對、外展探訪、暫託交通津貼。聽障/言語障礙WhatsApp 5322 2183。
why_en: Your household has care needs — save this number.
why_zh: 如家中有照顧需要，建議儲存此號碼以備不時之需。
proof_needed_zh: 無需文件 — 歡迎直接來電

title_en: Day Respite Service for the Elderly (60+)
title_zh: 長者日間暫託服務 (60歲+)
value_summary_en: Short-term day care so carers can rest. Via 182 183, IFSC/MSSU, or direct to centres. 349 locations.
value_summary_zh: 短暫日間照顧，讓照顧者稍事休息。經182 183、綜合家庭服務中心或直接向中心申請。全港349個服務點。
confirm_en: Aged 60+
Needs personal/limited nursing care
confirm_zh: 年滿60歲
需個人/有限度護理
why_en: Your household has an elderly member who may need breaks cover.
why_zh: 如家中有長者，照顧者需要休息時便可使用。

title_en: Residential Respite Service for the Elderly (60+)
title_zh: 長者住宿暫託服務 (60歲+)
value_summary_en: Temporary residential care when carers unavailable. No SCNAMES needed. Check vacancies at VES, referral via social worker.
value_summary_zh: 照顧者暫時未能照顧時短期入住。免統一評估，上VES查空位，經社工轉介。
confirm_en: Aged 60+
Family takes back after respite period
confirm_zh: 年滿60歲
暫託期滿接返屋企
why_en: Backup when you as carer are away or ill.
why_zh: 照顧者有事離開或病倒時的後備。

title_zh: $2優惠計劃 (60歲以下殘疾人士)
value_summary_en: Same $2/80%-off via Personalised Octopus with Disabilities Status. SWD mails pre-verified form on DA/CSSA approval.
value_summary_zh: 同享$2/8折，用殘疾身份個人八達通。批出傷殘津貼/綜援時社署會寄已核實申請表。
why_en: Disabled member under 60 — apply for the status Octopus.
why_zh: 家有60歲以下殘疾成員 — 申請殘疾身份八達通。

title_en: Training Subsidy Programme for Children on Waitlist of Subvented Pre-school Rehabilitation Services
title_zh: 輪候資助學前康復服務兒童學習訓練津貼
value_summary_en: Subsidy for private training while under-6 child waits for subvented pre-school rehab (not receiving any). Income ≤75% MMDHI. SWD invites by letter.
value_summary_zh: 6歲以下輪候資助學前康復(未接受任何服務)可申請私人訓練津貼，入息≤住戶每月入息中位數75%。社署會寄信邀請。
confirm_en: Child under 6 on CRSRehab waitlist
Receiving NO subvented pre-school rehab
Income ≤75% MMDHI for EETC/IP/OPRS waitlist
confirm_zh: 子女6歲以下輪候康復服務中央轉介系統
未接受任何資助學前康復服務
入息≤住戶每月入息中位數75%
why_en: Your child has SEN and your income is in range — watch for SWD letter.
why_zh: 你子女有特殊需要且入息範圍符合 — 等社署信。
proof_needed_zh: 康復服務中央轉介系統輪候信
入息證明(≤住戶每月入息中位數75%)

title_zh: 到校學前康復服務 (約10,000名額)
value_summary_en: School-based rehab at ~900 KGs for under-6 with mild disabilities. Free. Apply via CRSRehab with paediatrician/psychologist referral.
value_summary_zh: 約900間幼稚園到校康復，6歲以下輕度殘疾免費。經CRSRehab+兒科/心理醫生轉介申請。
confirm_en: Child assessed with mild disabilities
Attending KG in OPRS network
confirm_zh: 子女評估為輕度殘疾
就讀OPRS網絡幼稚園
why_en: KG-age child with SEN — earliest help in the prime window.
why_zh: 幼稚園SEN子女 — 把握學習黃金期及早支援。
proof_needed_zh: 專業評估(兒科/心理醫生)
幼稚園學位(參與計劃學校)

title_en: Short-term Food Assistance Service (up to 8 weeks)
title_zh: 短期食物援助服務 (最長8星期)
value_summary_en: Free basic food up to 8 weeks for sudden hardship (unemployed, low-income, new arrivals, street sleepers). Contact team by residence.
value_summary_zh: 突變困境(失業、低收入、新來港、露宿)免費基本食物最長8星期。按居住地區聯絡服務隊。
confirm_en: Sudden financial hardship
Income/assets within Apr 2026 limits table
confirm_zh: 突發經濟困難
入息資產符合2026年4月限額表
why_en: Low income — know this exists before crisis hits.
why_zh: 低收入家庭 — 及早了解，急時有人幫。

value_summary_en: Monthly pass for mobility-impaired HKID holders (under-11 HK residents incl.). Escorts allowed. CSSA/RCSV holders get Dial-a-Ride half fare.
value_summary_zh: 行動不便持香港身份證者月票(11歲以下香港居民都得)。可有人陪搭。綜援/RCSV坐電召半價。
confirm_en: Mobility impairment (escort allowed)
confirm_zh: 行動不便(可陪搭)
why_en: Mobility-impaired member — cheapest accessible transport.
why_zh: 家有行動不便成員 — 實惠的無障礙交通選擇。

title_en: Special Needs Trust (estate planning for SEN kids)
title_zh: 特殊需要信託 (為SEN子女安排身後財產)
value_summary_en: DSW as trustee manages deceased parents' assets, disburses to carers per wishes. For ID/autism/mental-disorder beneficiaries. 18+ HKPR settlor, not bankrupt.
value_summary_zh: 社署署長做法定受託人，按父母意願定期發放財產給照顧者。受益人為智障/自閉/精神障礙。委託人須18歲+香港永久居民、非破產。
confirm_en: Beneficiary: intellectual disability / autism / mental disorder
Settlor 18+, HKPR, not bankrupt
confirm_zh: 受益人：智障/自閉/精神障礙
委託人18歲+、香港永久居民、非破產
why_en: SEN child in family — plan decades ahead, not years.
why_zh: 家有SEN子女 — 為十年後的需要及早打算。
proof_needed_zh: 委託人香港永久居民+償債能力

title_zh: 社區牙科支援計劃 (任何年齡)
value_summary_en: Replaces CCF dental (ended Jan 2026). Subsidised checkup/scale/extract/fill/X-ray/root canal. Admin fee waived for 75+ OALA, Level-1 home care, full-waiver holders. Hotline 2111 3403.

value_summary_en: 30/50/100% of DAE/DYJ tuition back by AFI level (FULL/HALF via EC; 30% base with pass + 80% attendance). Choose DAE or evening courses, not both.
value_summary_zh: 按入息審查發還DAE/毅進學費30/50/100%（全額／半額憑資格證明；有及格＋80%出席率保底30%）。夜中學只能二選一。
proof_needed_zh: 應用教育文憑／毅進入學
confirm_en: Same-year DAE vs evening-course choice is exclusive
confirm_zh: 同年DAE與夜中學只能二選一
why_en: Second-chance diploma at home — most of the fee comes back.
why_zh: 家有人讀DAE／毅進 — 大部分學費返得到。

value_summary_en: From Apr 2026: $17,015/mo care-and-attention, $21,982 nursing. For SCNAMES-RCS elders on the CWL; invited in batches, apply via VISE.
value_summary_zh: 2026年4月起：照顧$17,015/月、護養$21,982/月。經統一評估需院舍並輪候冊等候長者；分批邀請，可經VISE申請。
confirm_en: Inactive CWL status or already-placed elders excluded
Level-0 holders: auto fee waiver path
confirm_zh: 凍結輪候或已入住者不合
零級券持有人走自動減免通道
why_en: Residential care in the family future — know the voucher before the crisis.
why_zh: 家中或需院舍照顧 — 危機前先認識此券。

title_zh: 薪俸稅：供養父母／祖父母免稅額（$55,000+）
value_summary_en: $55,000 per parent 60+ (or DA-eligible) + $55,000 more if living with you all year. 55-60: $27,500 + $27,500. Needs 6-month cohabit or $12k+ support.
confirm_en: 55-60 at half rate; DA-eligible any age at full rate
Only one taxpayer per parent — agree within family
Mainland-settled parents excluded
confirm_zh: 55-60歲半額；領傷殘津貼任何年齡全額
每名父母只限一名納稅人申索
定居內地父母不合
why_en: Supporting an elderly parent — cut your tax bill for it.
why_zh: 供養緊長者 — 減輕稅務負擔。

title_zh: 薪俸稅：子女免稅額（每名$140,000）
value_summary_en: $140,000 per child + $140,000 extra in birth year; from 2026/27 an additional allowance for the first 2 years after birth.
value_summary_zh: 每名子女$140,000，出生年度多$140,000；2026/27起出生後首兩年另有額外免稅額。
proof_needed_zh: 未婚＋（未滿18／18-25全日制讀書／殘疾）
confirm_en: Check the 2026/27 first-2-years top-up on IRD
confirm_zh: 2026/27首兩年加碼見稅局公布
why_en: Kids at home — $140k off taxable income each.
why_zh: 家有細路 — 每名減$140k應課稅入息。

title_zh: 薪俸稅：單親免稅額（$145,000）
value_summary_en: $145,000 on top of child allowance for a single parent with a maintained child meeting child-allowance conditions.
value_summary_zh: 單親父／母除子女免稅額外再加$145,000，子女須符合子女免稅額條件。
proof_needed_en: Maintained child as per child allowance
proof_needed_zh: 供養符合子女免稅額條件的子女
confirm_en: Separated/divorced/widowed or never-married with sole care
confirm_zh: 分居／離婚／喪偶或獨力照顧未婚子女
why_en: Raising kids solo — the tax code recognises it.
why_zh: 獨力湊大 — 稅制認可這份承擔。

title_zh: 薪俸稅：殘疾受養人免稅額（$75,000）
value_summary_en: $75,000 per DA-eligible dependant you maintain (spouse/child/parent/sibling meeting conditions). Medical certification required.
value_summary_zh: 每名供養並符合傷殘津貼的受養人（配偶／子女／父母／兄弟姊妹）$75,000。需醫生證明。
proof_needed_zh: 受養人符合傷殘津貼（已認證）
confirm_en: Dependant certified under DA/SSA definition
DA recipients themselves: separate $75k Personal Disability Allowance exists
confirm_zh: 受養人須符合傷殘津貼定義之認證
領傷殘津貼者另有$75k傷殘人士免稅額
why_en: Caring for a disabled dependant — claim the recognition.
why_zh: 照顧殘疾受養人 — 申索應得的認可。

title_en: Selective Placement: job matching for disabled jobseekers
title_zh: 展能就業科：殘疾求職者就業配對
value_summary_en: Free LD job matching, workplace visits, work-trial liaison and post-placement follow-up for disabled jobseekers. Gateway to WOPS/SPED employer incentives.
value_summary_zh: 勞工處免費就業配對、實地探訪、試工聯繫及入職跟進。通往WOPS／SPED僱主津貼之門。
confirm_en: Ask SPD about WOPS $60k and SPED $40k when placed
confirm_zh: 獲聘時問展能科WOPS $60k及SPED $4萬
why_en: Disabled and job-hunting — a dedicated team places you free.
why_zh: 殘疾求職中 — 專責團隊免費幫你配對。

title_zh: 指定夜間成人教育學費發還（30–100%，17歲+）
value_summary_en: 30/50/100% of evening secondary fees back by AFI level (FULL/HALF via EC; 30% base with attendance). 17+, designated centres. Choose evening OR DAE, not both.
value_summary_zh: 按入息審查發還夜中學費30/50/100%（全額／半額憑資格證明；有出席率保底30%）。17歲+、指定中心。夜中學與DAE只能二選一。
confirm_en: No repeating same level (unless switching to NSS curriculum)
Refund DAE first if switching pots
confirm_zh: 不可重讀同級（轉新高中學制除外）
轉計劃先退還DAE款項
why_en: Night school while working days — most of the fee comes back.
why_zh: 日頭返工夜晚讀書 — 大部分學費返得到。

title_en: Transitional Housing (move now, PRH limits apply)
title_zh: 過渡性房屋（即搬，入息資產跟公屋線）
value_summary_en: Cat A: PRH wait 3+yr (newborn families 2yr). Cat B: inadequate/urgent housing. Cat C: subdivided 6mo+. Rent-capped, apply via TH-E platform.
value_summary_zh: 甲類：輪候公屋3年+（新生嬰兒家庭2年）。乙類：居所不適切／急需。丙類：劏房6個月+。租金封頂，經TH-E平台申請。
proof_needed_zh: 入息資產在公屋限額內
confirm_en: Self-route Cat A/B/C by wait time and urgency
Up to 3 project choices; acceptance cancels the rest
confirm_zh: 按輪候年期及急切度自選甲／乙／丙類
最多選3個項目，獲接受即取消其餘
why_en: Bad housing now + PRH queue years away — bridge it.
why_zh: 現居惡劣＋公屋遙遙無期 — 先搭條橋。

title_en: Tung Wah Free Clinics (Chinese + Western, since 1870)
title_zh: 東華免費門診（中西醫，1870年至今）
value_summary_en: Free Chinese internal-medicine + bone-setting consults (TW/KW hospitals, queue tickets, no booking) and 1M+/yr free western consults. CSSA hospital fees waived.
value_summary_zh: 東華／廣華免費中醫內科＋跌打（排籌、免預約），每年逾百萬人次免費西醫門診。綜援住院費全免。
confirm_en: First-come tickets daily; check 2026 free-scheme updates
confirm_zh: 每日先到先得派籌；留意2026免費計劃更新
why_en: Free care with 150 years of history — queue early.
why_zh: 百年免費傳統 — 早到排籌就有。

title_zh: 鄰里支援幼兒照顧（上門$28/時，中心$20/時）
value_summary_en: Flexible 7am-11pm care for newborn-to-P kids of shift/unsupported parents, all 18 districts. Fee waiver for hardship. Or earn $40-60/hr as a home carer.
value_summary_zh: 輪班／無支援家長的新生至小學生彈性照顧（朝7晚11），18區都有。困難可免收費。亦可做褓姆賺$40-60/時。
proof_needed_zh: 輪班／不穩定工時或緊急需要
confirm_en: Call the district hotline 9am-9pm; SWD 2343 2255 after hours
Fee waiver via operator for hardship
confirm_zh: 打地區專線朝9晚9；深夜急事打社署2343 2255
困難戶經營辦機構申請減免
why_en: Shift work + little ones + no helper — this was built for you.
why_zh: 輪班兼湊年幼子女又無支援 — 此計劃正是為您而設。

title_zh: 廣東／福建計劃高齡／長者生活津貼（北上退休）
value_summary_en: Same OAA/OALA rates while residing in GD/FJ (60+ days/yr). 7yr HK resident + 1yr continuous stay before applying; apply in person in HK + interview.
value_summary_zh: 居廣東／福建照領高齡／長者生活津貼（每年住滿60日）。居港7年＋申請前連續住滿1年；親身來港辦手續＋面談。
proof_needed_zh: 親身來港面談＋旅遊證件
confirm_en: OALA means test still applies; OAA 70+ non-means
PRH tenants surrender unit before leaving
Apply within 1 month before 65th/70th birthday counts
confirm_zh: 長者生活津貼照要審查；高齡津貼70歲免審查
公屋戶離港前須交回單位
65／70歲生日前一個月可預先申請
why_en: Retired across the border — keep the allowance coming.
why_zh: 北上退休 — 津貼繼續發放。

title_zh: 長者中心會籍（$21/年，膳食＋輔導）
value_summary_en: DECC/NEC: $21/yr for 60+ (55-59 university $20, carers free). Meals, counselling, referrals, LTC applications, rehab-equipment loans.
value_summary_zh: 地區／鄰舍中心：60歲+$21/年（55-59學舍$20，照顧者免費）。膳食、輔導、轉介、長期護理申請、復康用品借用。
proof_needed_en: Walk in or call the district centre
confirm_en: Join the centre in your own district
Hidden-elderly outreach via Support Teams
confirm_zh: 參加所屬地區中心
隱蔽長者由外展隊跟進
why_en: The neighbourhood living room for 60+ — $21 a year.
why_zh: 60歲+街坊客廳 — 一年$21。

title_zh: 內地升學資助（高達$19,400/年，217間院校）
value_summary_en: Means-tested full/half ($8,900–$19,400 by distance) or non-means $5,900–$6,500 (DSE 3322 / principal nomination / Huaqiao) for HK students on the Mainland.
value_summary_zh: 經審查全額／半額（按距離$8,900–$19,400）或免審查$5,900–$6,500（DSE 3322／校長推薦／華僑大學），在內地升學港生。
confirm_en: Yearly application by 21 Sep
One subsidy type per year; clashes with TSFS/FASP excluded
Renewals notified individually
confirm_zh: 每年9月21日前申請
每年只限一種津貼；已領TSFS/FASP者不合
續領個別通知
why_en: Studying across the border — distance pays.
why_zh: 北上升學 — 路程遠資助多。

title_zh: 民間食物援助（綜援／傷殘／在職家庭＋轉介）
value_summary_en: Conservancy Association food aid for CSSA/CCF/DA/WFA holders, or unemployed / single parents / new immigrants / EM via social-worker referral. HKID + address + docs.
value_summary_zh: 長春社食物援助：綜援／關愛基金／傷殘／在職家庭戶，或失業／單親／新來港／少數族裔經社工轉介。需身份證＋住址＋文件。
proof_needed_en: Benefit proof or social-worker referral form
proof_needed_zh: 福利證明或社工轉介表
confirm_en: No SWD service needed — ask any social worker for the referral form
Feeding HK supplies charities, not walk-ins — go via partners
confirm_zh: 無社署服務亦可 — 請任何社工索取轉介表
樂餉只供機構不直接派 — 經夥伴機構
why_en: Food stress now — no SWD case needed, any social worker unlocks it.
why_zh: 糧食有壓力 — 無需社署個案，任何社工均可轉介。

title_zh: 母嬰健康院兒童健康服務（免費，0-5歲）
value_summary_en: Free growth + immunisation + development checks birth-to-5 at MCHCs, plus antenatal/postnatal and $1 family planning. Non-eligible $365/visit.
value_summary_zh: 母嬰健康院0-5歲免費生長＋防疫注射＋發展監測，另有產前產後及$1家計服務。非合資格每次$365。
confirm_en: Book MCHC ahead — newborn jaundice/breastfeeding seen fast
Parenting talks mostly in Cantonese
confirm_zh: 預約母嬰健康院 — 初生黃疸／餵哺問題優先見
親職講座多為廣東話
why_en: Baby at home — free jabs, weighing and advice on schedule.
why_zh: 家有BB — 免費打針磅重加指導，跟時間表。

title_zh: 資助中醫門診（$120，18區）
value_summary_en: $120 per visit (consult + acupuncture/bone-setting + up to 5 doses) at 18 district clinics, 800k quota/yr. CSSA + OALA-75+ auto-waived via online check.
value_summary_zh: 18區診所每次$120（診症＋針灸跌打＋最多5劑藥），每年80萬籌。綜援＋75歲+長者生活津貼線上核實自動免費。
proof_needed_zh: 綜援／75歲+長者生活津貼線上自動免費
confirm_en: Quota fills fast — book via 18 CM Clinics app
HCV cannot be used here
confirm_zh: 籌額搶手 — 用18區中醫診所App搶
醫療券不適用
why_en: Subsidised herbal care in your district — $120 all-in.
why_zh: 屋企附近資助中醫 — $120全包。

title_zh: 幼稚園教育計劃（半日制免費）
value_summary_en: Scheme-KGs: half-day local classes free; whole-day fees capped ($30,540/yr post-subsidy). Needs RC. Registration fee caps $970/$1,570.
value_summary_zh: 計劃幼稚園本地課程半日制免費；全日制收費封頂（資助後$30,540/年）。須持註冊證。註冊費上限$970/$1,570。
confirm_en: Choose half-day for zero fees; compare whole-day net fees on the Fees Certificate
KCFRS stacks on top for needy families
confirm_zh: 揀半日制零學費；全日制睇收費證比較實付
有需要家庭再疊加學費減免
why_en: Choosing a KG now — half-day can cost nothing.
why_zh: 揀緊幼稚園 — 半日制可以零學費。

title_en: Light Public Housing (~90% PRH rent, keep your queue)
title_zh: 簡約公屋（約九成公屋租，保留輪候）
value_summary_en: PRH wait 3yr+ families move in fast at ~90% PRH rent, keep PRH queue position. Priority: inadequate housing, medical needs, kids/elderly/newborns.
value_summary_zh: 輪候公屋3年+家庭快上車，租金約九成公屋租，保留公屋隊。劏房、病患、有細佬長者初生優先。
proof_needed_zh: 入息資產在公屋限額內
confirm_en: Forms mailed in batches — watch the post
Moving in forfeits Cash Allowance Trial Scheme
confirm_zh: 表格分批郵寄 — 留意信箱
入住即停發現金津貼試驗計劃
why_en: PRH queue years long + subdivided flat now — jump it.
why_zh: 公屋隊長劏房窄 — 先入住過渡。

title_en: HKDSE Exam Fee Remission (Full = free, Half = 50%)
title_zh: 文憑試考試費減免（全免／半免）
value_summary_en: S6 first-time school candidates with SFO Full/Half: fees free or halved ($777 languages, $519 others). School applies Sep-Oct; late = pay first, refund later.
value_summary_zh: 中六首次應考＋資助全額／半額：考試費全免或半價（語文$777，其他$519）。經學校9-10月申請；遲申請先付後退。
proof_needed_zh: 資助全額／半額資格證明
confirm_en: CSSA families claim from SWD directly
Evening-centre + ApL-only candidates included
confirm_zh: 綜援戶直接向社署申領
夜中學＋應用學習單科考生都包
why_en: S6 at home this year — don't pay exam fees you needn't.
why_zh: 屋企有中六 — 可減免的考試費不用繳付。

title_zh: 免費戒煙支援（熱線1833 183）
value_summary_en: Free nurse counselling, NRT trial packs by mail, acupuncture options and HA clinics. 24hr info in Cantonese/Mandarin/English.
value_summary_zh: 免費護士輔導、戒煙藥郵寄試用裝、針灸選擇及醫管局診所。24小時廣東話／普通話／英語資訊。
proof_needed_zh: 診所藥物需香港身份證
confirm_en: Mail-to-quit needs 3 working days after assessment
Pregnant/chronic/allergy cases see a doctor first
confirm_zh: 郵寄戒煙藥評估後3個工作天寄到
懷孕／長期病／藥物敏感先見醫生
why_en: Smoking in the house — free help that actually works.
why_zh: 屋企有人食煙 — 免費又有成效的幫助。

title_zh: 職學計劃（有薪＋$9萬津貼＋$3.6萬培訓）
value_summary_en: S3+ leavers: guaranteed salary ≥$10,780/mo + gov allowance up to $90k + $1k/mo training allowance + $30.8k industry incentive. Diploma to Higher Diploma, 8 industries.
value_summary_zh: 中三以上：保證月薪$10,780+政府津貼高達$9萬＋每月$1k培訓津貼＋$30,800行業獎金。文憑至高級文憑，8大行業。
confirm_en: Needs an employer contract — apply via VTC portal + industry fairs
Upskilling $30k more after graduation
confirm_zh: 須有僱主合約 — 經VTC招生網＋行業展覽申請
畢業後進修再多$3萬
why_en: Hands-on learner at home — paid to learn a trade.
why_zh: 屋企有手作仔 — 學師有糧出。

title_en: Become a Foster Parent (~$11,000/mo incentive, tax-free)
title_zh: 成為寄養家長（每月約$11,000獎勵，免稅）
value_summary_en: ~$11k/mo ordinary (~$13k emergency) + maintenance grant + SEN/under-6 extras + tuition support. Any healthy adult incl. singles; home assessment; one-plus-one with friends.
value_summary_zh: 普通每月約$11k（緊急約$13k）＋生活津貼＋SEN／6歲以下額外＋補習支援。任何健康成人包括單身可申請；家訪評估；可與親友一加一。
confirm_en: A calling, not a benefit — home study + referees
Short-term relief care also welcome
confirm_zh: 這是召命不是福利 — 家訪＋諮詢人
短期替假照顧亦歡迎
why_en: Spare room, spare love — 1,112 families and counting.
why_zh: 有多間房多份愛 — 已有1,112個家庭。

title_zh: 智友醫社同行計劃（綜援／長生津／減免免費）
value_summary_en: Support for mild/moderate dementia via DECC: free for CSSA/OALA/waiver holders, else $150/mo. Geriatric/HA referral; discretionary waivers.
value_summary_zh: 輕中度認知障礙經長者中心支援：綜援／長生津／減免免費，其他$150/月。需老人科／醫管局轉介；酌情減免。
confirm_en: Ask the DECC about discretionary waiver if stuck
confirm_zh: 有困難問中心酌情減免
why_en: Early dementia in the family — supported, not alone.
why_zh: 家人初現認知障礙 — 有支援，不孤單。

title_en: Free Legal Advice (Duty Lawyer, 9 districts, no means test)
title_zh: 免費法律諮詢（當值律師，9區，免審查）
value_summary_en: 20-30 min with a volunteer lawyer, evenings 6:30-8:30pm. No means test, completely free. Book via referral agency (IFSC/HAEC/Caritas); ~3-4 week wait, 2 weeks urgent.
value_summary_zh: 義務律師20-30分鐘諮詢，晚6:30-8:30。免入息審查，完全免費。經轉介機構（綜合家庭服務中心／民政諮詢中心／明愛）預約；約等3-4星期，急件2星期。
proof_needed_en: Genuine case details (no-shy applicants get no slot)
Book at referral agency, not the centre
proof_needed_zh: 真實案情（須說明案情方可預約）
去轉介機構預約，請勿直接前往中心
confirm_en: Preliminary advice only — no follow-up or representation
Legal-aid/private-lawyer clients excluded
confirm_zh: 僅屬初步意見 — 無跟進無代表出庭
已有法援／私家律師者不合
why_en: Legal trouble in the family — 30 free minutes first.
why_zh: 屋企遇上法律煩惱 — 先用免費30分鐘。

Unchanged $75k in 2026/27

title_zh: 港鐵全月通（5款，接駁75折）

confirm_en: Excl. First Class / Airport Express / Lo Wu-Lok Ma Chau

why_zh: 日日同一條港鐵線 — 月費封頂最抵。

title_zh: 免入息審查專上貸款NLSFT+NLSPS（終身$419,400，2.173%）

why_zh: 要交大專學費 — 免審查先借後還。

title_en: Extended Non-means-tested Loan ENLS ($419,400, to Jul 2027)
title_zh: 擴展免入息審查貸款ENLS（$419,400，至2027年7月）
value_summary_en: Tuition loan for eligible post-secondary/continuing/professional courses in HK (incl. CEF-type). Own lifetime pot $419,400 (2026/27), 2.173%. Apply by 31 Jul 2027 before lectures end.

confirm_en: Separate pot from NLSFT/NLSPS
Pairs with cef-25k reimbursement courses
confirm_zh: 與NLSFT／NLSPS分開計算
可配持續進修基金發還課程
why_en: Adult upskilling on credit — no means test.
why_zh: 成年進修碌卡讀 — 免審查貸款。

title_en: Racial Diversity Employment (free EM job support, 6mo)
title_zh: 種族多元就業計劃（免費少數族裔就業支援，6個月）
value_summary_en: Free one-stop help for ethnic-minority jobseekers: NGO case manager, counselling, job matching, post-placement support. 6 months per enrolment. Hotline 2150 6359.
value_summary_zh: 免費一站式少數族裔求職支援：NGO個案經理、輔導、配對、入職跟進。每期6個月。熱線2150 6359。

proof_needed_zh: 網站／機構／勞工處就業中心登記

Re-enrol after 6 months if needed
confirm_zh: 免費；登記即成勞工處求職者
6個月後可再參加
why_en: EM and job-hunting — a case manager, free.
why_zh: 少數族裔搵工 — 免費個案經理幫手。

title_zh: 香港特別行政區政府獎學基金（本地每年$40,000）
value_summary_en: $40k/yr local ($80k non-local) for outstanding full-time publicly-funded sub-degree/degree+ students. Institution-nominated (academics + leadership + service).
value_summary_zh: 全日制資助副學位／學位+優異生本地每年$40k（非本地$80k）。院校提名（成績＋領袖＋服務）。
proof_needed_en: Full-time publicly-funded place (8 UGC + HKAPA + VTC)

confirm_en: Ask your institution (nominations ~Oct/Nov)
Tenable for normal programme duration
confirm_zh: 問院校（約10／11月提名）
資助至正常修業期
why_en: Top grades at uni — $40k a year says well done.
why_zh: 大學成績標青 — 每年$40k獎勵。

title_zh: 自資專上獎學金（卓越表現每年$40,000）
value_summary_en: Outstanding Performance: $40k/yr local degree ($80k non-local), $30k sub-degree. Full-time accredited self-financing, Year 2+, CGPA 3.23+ or top non-academic awards. Via institution quota.
value_summary_zh: 卓越表現：本地學位每年$40k（非本地$80k），副學位$30k。全日制認可自資，二年級+、GPA 3.23+或頂尖非學術獎。經院校配額。
confirm_en: Also TDS/BPA/ROA/EDS tracks — ask institution
Sibling: hksar-gov-scholarship (publicly-funded side)
EN-only site (no TC tree) — EDB amounts page
confirm_zh: 另有才藝／最佳進步等組別 — 問院校
姊妹：政府獎學基金（資助學額）
why_en: Self-financing but stellar — $40k recognises it.
why_zh: 讀自資但成績勁 — $40k肯定你。

title_en: Outreach Dental for Care-Home Elderly (free, on-site)
title_zh: 長者牙科外展（院舍免費上門）
value_summary_en: Free on-site check-up + treatment for RCHE/nursing-home/C&A-blind-home residents (any age with HKID) or 60+ day-care users. 25 NGO teams, ~481k attendances. No means test.
value_summary_zh: 持牌安老／護養／盲人院舍院友（任何年齡＋香港身份證）或60歲+日間中心用家免費上門檢查＋治療。25隊NGO，約48萬人次。免審查。
proof_needed_zh: 院舍住客或60歲+日間中心用家
confirm_en: Complex cases referred to dental clinic
Distinct from CDSP (community) and OOHP (preschool)
confirm_zh: 複雜症轉牙科診所
與社區牙科（CDSP）／學前（OOHP）不同
why_en: Elderly in residential care — dentist comes to them, free.
why_zh: 長者住緊院舍 — 牙醫上門免費睇。

title_zh: 女性健康衛星中心（64歲或以下，分擔收費篩查）
value_summary_en: Prevention-first women's checks (assessment, cervical + breast screening, nurse clinic) via DHC referral, co-pay model. Register as DHC member first. Chai Wan open Jun 2025; Lam Tin + Tuen Mun from Sep 2025.
value_summary_zh: 預防為本婦女檢查（評估、子宮頸＋乳房篩查、護士診所），經地區康健中心轉介、分擔收費。先入會DHC。柴灣2025年6月開；藍田＋屯門9月起。
confirm_en: Old DH well-woman clinics stopped new bookings Jan 2025
CSSA/waiver holders: same care at 7 HA GOPCs
confirm_zh: 舊衛生署婦女健康中心2025年1月停新症
綜援／減免戶：7間公院門診同類服務
why_en: Woman 64 or under — prevention beats cure, subsidised.
why_zh: 64歲或以下女性 — 預防勝治療，有資助。

title_en: HA Public IVF (up to 3 cycles, capped fees)
title_zh: 公營試管嬰兒（最多3個周期，收費封頂）
value_summary_en: Married couples, female <40 to start: up to 3 stimulation cycles at QMH/PWH/KWH. $135 first visit + $80 follow-ups, $4,000 drug pack, lab $9k-$40k/cycle. Quota rising to 1,800/yr.
value_summary_zh: 已婚夫婦、女方未滿40歲開始：瑪麗／威爾斯／廣華最多3個周期。$135首次＋$80覆診，$4,000藥包，化驗每周期$9k-$40k。名額增至每年1,800。
proof_needed_zh: 普通科／家計會轉介→專科評估
confirm_en: 9 HA hospitals assess; 3 do IVF
Pairs with ird-ar-100k ($100k tax deduction)
confirm_zh: 9間公院評估；3間做試管
可配$100k稅項扣除（ird-ar-100k）

why_zh: 要醫學幫助先有BB — 先行公營路。

value_summary_zh: 持牌中心試管／人工授精／配子處理：每年扣高達$100k（自己／配偶付款、自己／配偶接受，須醫學需要）。持牌醫生證明。2024/25年度起，可追6年。
proof_needed_zh: 持牌中心治療＋醫生簽署證明
confirm_en: Gazetted 28 Feb 2025; pairs with ha-ivf-public
Chemo/radio-induced infertility included

化療／電療致不育都包
why_en: Paying for IVF — $100k of it is tax-deductible.
why_zh: 自費試管 — $100k可扣稅。

Chronic DM/HT + mild episodic cases

長期糖尿血壓＋輕微偶發症

聯網跨校課程

why_zh: 退休想學嘢 — 重返校園，近乎免費。

title_zh: 學生精神健康支援（校隊＋公院護士）

why_zh: 仔女喺學校唔開心 — 有醫護團隊跟，唔止傾偈。

title_zh: 少數族裔支援中心（10間免費＋傳譯熱線）

why_zh: 少數族裔家庭 — 免費課程＋識你語言嘅熱線。

title_zh: 交通意外傷亡援助（$330/日×60日，免審查）

why_zh: 交通意外受傷 — 免審查現金援助。

title_en: Crime Victims Compensation (ex-gratia, no means test)
title_zh: 暴力及執法傷亡賠償（特惠金，免審查）
value_summary_en: Victims of violent crime / law-enforcement weapon use: ex-gratia award on common-law damages basis (death/disability/injury schedule). Non-contributory, no means test. Apply within 3 years.
value_summary_zh: 暴力罪行／執法武器傷亡受害人：按普通法損害基準特惠賠償（死亡／傷殘／受傷表）。非供款、免審查。事發3年內申請。
proof_needed_zh: 住院／病假3日+或死亡傷殘
confirm_en: Board-assessed; separate from TAVA traffic scheme
Re-apply window: 3yr or 1yr after withdrawal
confirm_zh: 委員會評定；與交通意外分開
再申請：3年或撤回後1年
why_en: Hurt by crime — the state compensates, no means test.
why_zh: 暴力罪行受害 — 政府賠償，免審查。

title_zh: 緊急救援基金（火災風災水災現金＋收容）
value_summary_en: Fire/typhoon/flood/landslide/collapse victims + closure-order evacuees: urgent cash relief (not compensation) + evacuation centres/food/shelter. Apply within 6 months.
value_summary_zh: 火災／颱風／水浸／山泥／塌樓受害人＋封閉令撤離戶：緊急現金救濟（非賠償）＋收容中心／膳食／棲身。事發6個月內申請。
confirm_en: SWD covers injury/death; Lands/Marine/AFCD other losses
Relief, not compensation
confirm_zh: 社署管傷亡；地政／海事／漁護管其他損失
救濟唔係賠償
why_en: Disaster just hit — cash and shelter first, questions later.
why_zh: 啱啱遇災 — 先有現金同收容。

title_zh: 體恤安置（社署特快上公屋）
value_summary_en: Genuine imminent long-term housing need on social/medical grounds with no alternative: SWD recommends, HD allocates ASAP (no district choice, refurbished flat OK). Must pass PRH limits.
value_summary_zh: 有迫切長期住屋需要（社會／醫療原因、別無他法）：社署推薦、房署盡快編配（無得揀區、翻新單位要受）。須過公屋限額。
proof_needed_zh: 社署／機構社工＋專員認可
公屋入息資產＋物業審查
confirm_en: Conditional Tenancy path for divorcing persons
Sibling: prh-apply (normal queue)
confirm_zh: 離婚待判者走有條件租約
姊妹：正常輪候（prh-apply）
why_en: Housing crisis with nowhere else to turn — the fast track exists.
why_zh: 住屋危機走投無路 — 特快通道喺度。

title_zh: 有需要業主維修津貼$80,000（長者業主）
value_summary_en: Owner-occupiers 60+ (or OALA/CSSA/DA with tests): up to $80k per owner/property for flat + common-area safety works. Max 4 claims in 10 years. Via URA. (Old $40k elderly scheme closed 2020.)
value_summary_zh: 60歲+自住業主（或長生津／綜援／傷殘津貼經審查）：每業主／物業高達$80k做單位＋公用安全工程。10年最多4次。經市建局。（舊$40k長者計劃2020年停。）
proof_needed_zh: 香港身份證＋自住業主＋同住配偶
60歲+入息資產審查（或長生津／綜援／傷殘）
confirm_en: Pro-rata by ownership share; repays BD/HKHS/URA loans OK
Sibling: lad-olas for building disputes
confirm_zh: 按業權攤分；可還屋宇署／房協／市建局貸款
大廈糾紛問法援（lad-olas）
why_en: Elderly owner, crumbling flat — $80k to fix it safe.
why_zh: 長者業主樓殘 — $80k整返安全。

title_en: Express Flat Allocation (self-pick PRH, 50% off stale flats)
title_zh: 特快公屋編配（自選樓，冷門單位半價租）
value_summary_en: Valid PRH applicants self-pick less-popular flats for early allocation (no district limit). Long-vacancy flats 50% off. EFAS 2026 selection from 2 Sep 2026 (applied Jul 2026). Yearly exercise.
value_summary_zh: 合資格公屋申請人自選冷門單位早著（唔限區）。長期空置單位半價租。2026年9月2日起揀樓（7月已收表）。每年一期。
proof_needed_en: Valid PRH application meeting exercise cutoff
proof_needed_zh: 有效公屋申請＋符合該期截數
confirm_en: EFAS 2026: batch 1 (2+ persons) then 1-person
Sibling: prh-apply, transitional-housing, lph-light-housing
confirm_zh: 2026年：先2人+後單人
姊妹：輪候／過渡屋／簡約公屋
why_en: In the PRH queue and flexible — jump it with self-pick.
why_zh: 排緊公屋又唔揀區 — 自選樓快著。

value_summary_en: $145,000 off for every salaries-tax/personal-assessment taxpayer from 2026/27 ($132k before). Automatic unless on married allowance. Law passed May 2026.
value_summary_zh: 2026/27起每名薪俸／個人入息課稅人減$145,000（之前$132k）。除非用已婚免稅額，否則自動有。2026年5月通過。
proof_needed_zh: 薪俸稅／個人入息課稅人
confirm_en: No claim needed; BIR60 yearly
Sibling: ird-married-allowance ($290k if married)
confirm_zh: 免申請；每年BIR60
姊妹：已婚$290k（ird-married-allowance）
why_en: Everyone paying salaries tax — $145k off, automatic.
why_zh: 有交薪俸稅人人有 — 自動減$145k。

value_summary_en: $290,000 off for married taxpayers from 2026/27 ($264k before). Married any time in year, not living apart; spouse no income or joint/personal assessment.
value_summary_zh: 2026/27起已婚納稅人減$290,000（之前$264k）。年內任何時間已婚、分開報稅除外；配偶無入息或合併／個人入息課稅。
proof_needed_en: Married in year, not living apart
confirm_en: BIR60/IR831 within 6 years
Replaces basic allowance (can't stack)
confirm_zh: BIR60／IR831，6年內
取代基本免稅額（唔疊得）
why_en: Married — $290k off the joint burden.
why_zh: 已婚 — 減$290k。

title_zh: 薪俸稅：供養兄弟姊妹（每名$37,500）
value_summary_en: $37,500 per unmarried sibling you maintain: <18, or 18-24 full-time study, or 18+ unable to work (disability). Sole/predominant care.
value_summary_zh: 每名供養未婚兄弟姊妹$37,500：未滿18、或18-24全日制讀書、或18歲+因殘疾不能工作。獨力／主要供養。
proof_needed_zh: 兄弟姊妹年齡／讀書／殘疾證明
confirm_en: Unchanged $37,500 since 2020/21
Stacks with child/parent allowances
confirm_zh: 可疊子女／父母免稅額
why_en: Supporting a sibling — $37.5k recognition.
why_zh: 供養緊細佬妹 — $37,500認可。

title_zh: 建造學院技能培訓（免費＋$10,000/月）
value_summary_en: Aged 18+, work-eligible: free full-time construction trade training + $10,000/mo attendance allowance + retention bonus (~$12,910/mo avg on 105-day courses). Rolling intakes.
value_summary_zh: 18歲+可合法工作：免費全日制建造業技能培訓＋$10,000/月出席津貼＋留任獎（105日課程月均約$12,910）。循環招生。
confirm_en: EN-only site (no TC tree)
Courses: CZTA/CZMW/CZGG trades; payout by attendance
confirm_zh: 英文站（無中文版）
課程：CZTA／CZMW／CZGG工種；按出席率發放
why_en: Hands-on and 18+ — trained free, paid $10k a month.
why_zh: 18歲+肯做嘢 — 免費學師兼月拎$10k。

title_en: RPL Assessment Fee Back in Full (100%)
title_zh: 過往資歷認可評估費全額發還（100%）
value_summary_en: Working practitioners passing an RPL cluster assessment: 100% of the assessment fee back after the Statement of Attainment. Apply within 2 years of SoA.
value_summary_zh: 在職人士通過資歷認可組合評估：攞到能力單元證明後發還100%評估費。證明發出2年內申請。
proof_needed_zh: 經指定評核機構攞證明
confirm_en: Experience certified free — fee refunded
Stacks with CEF-eligible upskilling
confirm_zh: 經驗認證免費 — 評估費退返
可配持續進修基金課程
why_en: Years of skill, no paper — certify it for free.
why_zh: 多年經驗無文憑 — 免費認證佢。

title_en: Social Hygiene Clinics (free STI check + treatment)
title_zh: 社會衞生科（免費性病檢查＋治療）
value_summary_en: Eligible HKID holders: free STI/leprosy check-up, treatment + confidential counselling at 6 clinics (Wan Chai, Yau Ma Tei, Kwun Tong, Tuen Mun, Fanling…). Walk in, no referral.
value_summary_zh: 合資格香港身份證持有人：6間診所免費性病／痲瘋檢查治療＋保密輔導（灣仔、油麻地、觀塘、屯門、粉嶺…）。免預約免轉介。
proof_needed_zh: 合資格人士（香港身份證／11歲以下香港居民）
confirm_en: Male/female sessions; all info confidential
Fee schedule: no charge (updated Jan 2026)
confirm_zh: 分男女應診時段；資料保密
收費表：免費（2026年1月更新）
why_en: Worried and waiting — free, confidential, walk in.
why_zh: 擔心又唔敢問 — 免費保密，直接去。

title_en: Financial Assistance Scheme for Family Members of Those Who Sacrifice Their Lives to Save Others $6M-$12M
title_zh: 為拯救他人而犧牲生命者家屬的經濟援助計劃 $600萬-$1,200萬
value_summary_en: One-off grant $6M-$12M based on age, normal retirement age and prevailing median monthly employment earnings. For families of persons who lost their lives attempting to save or protect others.
value_summary_zh: 一次性資助 $600萬至$1,200萬，依年齡、正常退休年齡及現行每月就業收入中位數計算。為嘗試拯救或保護他人而犧牲生命者之家屬。
why_en: You are family of someone who died saving or protecting others.
why_zh: 你是為拯救或保護他人而犧牲生命者的家屬。
